js: (async () => { const D = window.__DEBUG__, G = D.G, t = D.track, car = D.car; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const sites = []; for (let s = 300; s < 2300 && sites.length < 16; s += 7) { const i = t.index(s); for (const side of [1, -1]) { let ok = true; for (let k = i; k < i + 40 && k < t.pts.length; k++) { const h = side > 0 ? t.pts[k].hardL : t.pts[k].hardR; if (h !== Infinity || t.pts[k].tunnel) { ok = false; break; } } if (ok) { sites.push([s, side]); s += 60; break; } } } const out = []; for (const [s, side] of sites) { for (const kmh of [60, 100]) { D.teleport(s, kmh); let T = 0, air = 0, airT = 0, maxGap = 0, maxVy = 0, lastAir = false, hops = 0, maxH = 0; window.__AUTOPILOT__ = (dt) => { T += dt; const steer = T < 0.45 ? side * 0.55 : T < 0.8 ? -side * 0.25 : 0; return { throttle: 1, brake: 0, steer, hand: 0, reverse: false, touch: false }; }; window.__ONFRAME__ = (dt) => { const fl = G.floor; if (!fl || D.magnet.active) return; const gap = G.carY - fl.y; if (gap > maxGap) maxGap = gap; if (G.vy > maxVy) maxVy = G.vy; if (car.air) { airT += dt; if (!lastAir) air++; } lastAir = car.air; if (gap > 0.05 && !fl.onRoad) hops += dt; }; await sleep(2600); window.__AUTOPILOT__ = null; window.__ONFRAME__ = null; out.push([s, side, kmh, air, +airT.toFixed(2), +maxGap.toFixed(2), +maxVy.toFixed(1), +hops.toFixed(2)]); } } const sum = out.reduce((a, r) => { a.air += r[3]; a.airT += r[4]; a.maxGap = Math.max(a.maxGap, r[5]); a.maxVy = Math.max(a.maxVy, r[6]); return a; }, { air: 0, airT: 0, maxGap: 0, maxVy: 0 }); sum.airT = +sum.airT.toFixed(2); return { sum, rows: out }; })()
